products.name: Aurelia Decorative Vase
products.description: A sculptural ceramic vase with a softly fluted body and a matte ivory glaze. The Aurelia is designed to hold its own on a console or shelf, and looks just as considered empty as it does with a single stem. Each piece is finished by hand, so subtle variation in tone and texture is expected and part of its character.
products.seo_title: Aurelia Decorative Vase — Fluted Ivory Ceramic
products.seo_description: A fluted ceramic decorative vase in warm matte ivory. A sculptural accent for consoles, shelves and sideboards.

products.name: Essential Oversized T-Shirt
products.description: The everyday tee, refined. A heavyweight cotton jersey with a boxy, oversized cut, dropped shoulders and a clean hem. The Ecru colourway is garment-dyed for a soft, lived-in hand from the first wear. Style it loose over denim or tuck it into tailoring.
products.seo_title: Essential Oversized T-Shirt — Ecru Heavyweight Cotton
products.seo_description: A heavyweight cotton oversized t-shirt in soft ecru with dropped shoulders and a relaxed, boxy fit.

products.name: Minimalist Tattoo Sticker Set
products.description: A curated sheet of fine-line temporary tattoos — botanical stems, small geometric marks and delicate script-free linework. Each design is easy to apply with water and typically lasts a few days on skin. A low-commitment way to try a placement before you commit.
products.seo_title: Minimalist Tattoo Sticker Set — Fine-Line Temporary Tattoos
products.seo_description: A sheet of fine-line minimalist temporary tattoos in black ink. Easy to apply and remove.

products.name: Signature Waist Bead Set
products.description: A hand-strung strand of small polished glass beads in burgundy, champagne gold and ivory, finished with a fine gold-tone clasp and adjustable chain. Wear it alone or layer with one of our other strands. Strung to order, so allow a little time before dispatch.

products.name: Modern Kitchen Utensil Set
products.description: A four-piece cooking set — ladle, slotted turner, serving spoon and whisk — with matte black heads and balanced handles. Heat-resistant and comfortable to hold, with a silhouette clean enough to leave on the counter. Hand wash to preserve the finish.

products.seo_description: A modern four-piece kitchen utensil set with matte black heads and balanced handles.

products.name: Everyday Comfort Slides
products.description: A padded slide in soft sand beige, built for the days that do not slow down. The wide strap is lined for comfort and the sole has just enough grip for everyday wear. Water-resistant and easy to wipe clean.

products.seo_description: Padded everyday slides in sand beige with a comfortable wide strap and grippy sole.

products.name: Everyday Luxe Shoulder Bag
products.description: A structured shoulder bag in deep burgundy with a slim champagne gold-tone clasp and a short strap that sits neatly under the arm. Lined interior with a single slip pocket — room for a phone, cardholder, keys and a small pouch. A considered everyday bag that dresses up as easily as it dresses down.
